beginner.summary: For participants new to cloud computing. Covers service models, identity, compute, storage, networking, managed databases, serverless, monitoring and cost on the major providers, ending with a deployed web application.
prerequisites: Comfortable with basic computer use and web browsers
A payment card or sponsored account for cloud free tiers
outcomes: Explain cloud models and shared responsibility
Deploy and secure compute, storage, network and database services

days.topic: Cloud Computing Concepts and Service Models
subtopics: Major providers: AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
days.lab_task: Create free-tier accounts on two providers, set a budget alert on each, and classify ten common services as IaaS, PaaS or SaaS with a reason for each.
days.deliverable: Two cost-controlled accounts and a service classification sheet
checks: Classify ten services as IaaS, PaaS or SaaS
At least nine classified correctly, each with a reason
Set a budget alert on one provider
Alert configured at the stated amount
Say who patches a VM's operating system and a managed database engine
Customer for the VM; provider for the managed engine
objectives: Explain cloud service and deployment models
Set up a cost-controlled cloud account

days.topic: Identity and Access in the Cloud
subtopics: Root and owner accounts with MFA
AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Cloud IAM
Audit logs of sign-ins and changes
days.lab_task: Protect the root or owner account with MFA, create a read-only developers group on one provider and an equivalent role on a second, and find both sign-ins in the audit logs.
days.deliverable: MFA settings, group and role assignments, and audit log entries
checks: Sign in as the read-only user and try to delete a resource
Sign in to the root or owner account
Search the audit log for the user's sign-in
Event found with time and source IP
objectives: Grant least-privilege access with groups and roles
Find sign-in and change events in audit logs

days.lab_task: Launch a Linux VM, install a web server, allow port 80 from anywhere and SSH only from your IP, then stop the VM and compare on-demand and spot prices for the same size.
days.deliverable: Running web server, firewall rules and a price comparison
checks: Browse to the VM's public IP
Connect with SSH from a different IP address
Explain which charges continue after the VM is stopped
Disk storage is still charged; compute is not
objectives: Launch and secure a virtual machine

days.topic: Cloud Storage: Object, Block and File
days.lab_task: Create a bucket, upload files, block public access, share one file with a link that expires in ten minutes, enable versioning and add a lifecycle rule that moves files older than 30 days to a cheaper tier.
days.deliverable: Configured bucket, share link test and lifecycle rule
checks: Open an object URL without signing in
Open the share link after it expires
Overwrite a versioned file and restore the old version
objectives: Choose object, block or file storage for a need
Reduce storage cost with tiers and lifecycle rules

days.topic: Cloud Networking: Networks, Subnets and Firewalls
days.lab_task: Build a network with a public and a private subnet, place a web VM in the public subnet and a database VM in the private one, and allow the database port only from the web subnet.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, firewall rules and connectivity results
checks: Reach the web VM from the internet
Reach the database VM from the internet
Connect from the web VM to the database port
Connection accepted from the web subnet
objectives: Design a network with public and private subnets
Explain routing to the internet and between subnets

days.lab_task: Create a small managed PostgreSQL instance, connect from the web VM, load sample data, then restore the database to a new instance from a backup.
days.deliverable: Managed database, sample data and restore evidence
checks: Connect from an address outside the allowed range
Backups enabled with a retention period
objectives: Create and connect to a managed database
Back up and restore a database
Choose between managed and self-managed databases

subtopics: Triggers: HTTP, storage events and schedules
days.lab_task: Write a function that runs when a file is uploaded to the bucket and logs the file name and size, then upload three files and check the logs.
days.deliverable: Deployed function and log evidence
checks: Three log entries with names and sizes
Upload a file to a different bucket
Set a 3-second timeout and add a 5-second wait
Function times out and the error is logged
objectives: Decide when serverless fits a workload

days.lab_task: Build a dashboard for the web VM with CPU and network metrics, create a CPU alarm that sends an email, and generate load to trigger it.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, alarm and alarm history
checks: Run a CPU stress command on the VM
Alarm fires and an email arrives
Query the logs for web server errors
Filter costs by a project tag
Cost shown for the tagged resources
objectives: Monitor resources with metrics and dashboards

days.lab_task: Estimate the monthly cost of the application built this week with a pricing calculator, tag every resource, and find and delete two idle resources.
days.deliverable: Cost estimate, tagged resource list and clean-up record
checks: Compare the estimate with charges so far
Two idle resources identified and deleted

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Deploy a Web Application on the Cloud
days.lab_task: Deploy a two-tier web application with a public web tier, a private managed database, file storage, an upload function, a dashboard with an alarm and a cost estimate, then present it.
days.deliverable: Working application, architecture diagram, dashboard, cost estimate and a 10-minute demo
checks: Use the application end to end
Data is saved and uploaded files are processed
Try to reach the database from the internet
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one deployment
Secure and monitor a simple application

intermediate.summary: For participants who already use one cloud. Covers comparing providers, infrastructure as code, managed Kubernetes, identity federation, hybrid networking, analytics, CI/CD, security posture and disaster recovery.
prerequisites: Has deployed resources on at least one cloud provider
Comfortable with Linux, Git and the command line
Knows basic networking: IP addresses, subnets and DNS
outcomes: Choose and map services across providers
Secure identities and posture across clouds

subtopics: Mapping services across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
Compute, storage, database and network equivalents
days.lab_task: Map a reference e-commerce architecture to all three providers, then write a decision record choosing one provider for a stated data-residency requirement.
days.deliverable: Service mapping table and decision record
checks: Every component has an equivalent on each provider or a noted gap
Only regions that meet it are chosen
A reason is given with its trade-off

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform Across Providers
subtopics: Terraform workflow: init, plan and apply
Providers for AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
days.lab_task: Write a Terraform module that creates a network and a VM, deploy it to two providers, and store state remotely with locking.
days.deliverable: Module code, two deployments and lock test output
checks: Run apply from two terminals at once
Second run waits or fails on the state lock
Environment rebuilt with no manual steps
objectives: Manage infrastructure on several providers as code

days.topic: Containers and Managed Kubernetes in the Cloud
days.lab_task: Push an image to a cloud registry, deploy it to a managed Kubernetes cluster with two replicas behind a load balancer, and scale until the autoscaler adds a node.
days.deliverable: Deployed application, manifests and scaling evidence
checks: Browse to the load balancer address
objectives: Choose between Kubernetes and serverless containers

days.lab_task: Configure single sign-on so users from one identity provider sign in to a second cloud's console, and let a pipeline deploy with workload identity federation instead of stored keys.
days.deliverable: SSO configuration, role mapping and pipeline evidence
checks: Access granted with the mapped role
Run the pipeline with no stored keys
Disable the user in the identity provider

subtopics: Dedicated connections: Direct Connect, ExpressRoute and Cloud Interconnect
days.lab_task: Connect two cloud networks with a site-to-site VPN, resolve private DNS names across them, and calculate the egress cost of moving 1 GB between them.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, VPN configuration, DNS tests and cost calculation
checks: Ping a private IP across the VPN
Resolve a private name from the other network
Calculate the egress cost for 1 GB
Cost calculated from the published prices

days.topic: Data Services and Analytics Across Clouds
subtopics: Managed warehouses: Redshift, Azure Synapse and BigQuery
days.lab_task: Load the same Parquet dataset into two managed warehouses, run three identical queries, and compare results, run time, data scanned and cost.
days.deliverable: Load scripts, query results and a comparison sheet
checks: Run the three queries on both warehouses
Difference explained by each pricing model
objectives: Load and query data in managed warehouses
Compare analytics services on cost and speed

days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that runs tests, applies Terraform after approval, deploys the application with a canary release, and rolls back a faulty version.
days.deliverable: Pipeline definition and deployment history
checks: Push a commit that fails tests
Canary detects the errors and rolls back
objectives: Release safely with canaries and rollback
Protect secrets and environments in pipelines

subtopics: Security baselines such as CIS benchmarks
Posture tools: Security Hub, Defender for Cloud and Security Command Center
Encryption at rest and in transit
days.lab_task: Enable the posture tool on one provider, fix the three highest-severity findings in the lab account, and add a policy that blocks public storage.
days.deliverable: Findings before and after, and the policy definition
checks: Check encryption on storage and the database

subtopics: Pilot light, warm standby and active-active
days.lab_task: Set an RTO and RPO for the sample application, configure cross-region database backups, and run a failover drill to the second region with a runbook.
days.deliverable: RTO and RPO targets, backup configuration, drill timeline and runbook
checks: Lose the primary database in the drill
Service restored in the second region within the RTO
Check the age of the restored data
A second person follows the runbook
objectives: Back up and replicate across regions
Test recovery with drills and runbooks

subtopics: Infrastructure as code on two providers
days.lab_task: Deploy the application with Terraform on a primary provider, keep backups and a standby on a second, use single sign-on and workload identity, pass posture checks, and present it with a cost estimate.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline, drill results, findings report and a 15-minute demo
checks: Run the pipeline end to end
Application deployed with a canary release
Service restored on the second provider within the RTO
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For architects and senior engineers running production cloud estates. Covers architecture reviews, landing zones, FinOps, zero trust, platform engineering, multi-region resilience, data and AI platforms, migration and regulated cloud.
prerequisites: Has run production workloads on the cloud
Writes infrastructure as code and pipelines
Understands security, networking and cost basics on at least one provider
outcomes: Review and govern enterprise cloud architectures
Engineer cost, security and resilience at scale
Defend platform designs to decision makers

subtopics: Well-Architected frameworks of AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
Reliability, security, cost, performance, operations and sustainability
days.lab_task: Run a well-architected review of a provided production design, record the five highest risks with remediation and owners, and write two decision records.
days.deliverable: Risk register and two decision records
checks: Each has impact, likelihood and an owner
A peer reviews a decision record
Map each risk to a framework pillar

days.topic: Landing Zones and Multi-Account Governance at Scale
subtopics: AWS Organizations, Azure management groups and Google Cloud resource hierarchy
days.lab_task: Design a landing zone for 30 teams across two providers, implement guardrails that stop admins disabling audit logs, and create a new team environment from code.
days.deliverable: Landing zone design, guardrail code and vending evidence
checks: Disable audit logging as an administrator
Created with baseline policies and tags

subtopics: FinOps lifecycle: inform, optimise and operate
days.lab_task: Build a cost-allocation report by team from a provided billing export, find the three largest savings, and model a one-year commitment with its break-even month.
days.deliverable: Allocation report, savings list and commitment model
checks: At least 95 percent of spend allocated
Add a cost spike to the data

days.topic: Zero Trust Security Architecture in the Cloud
days.lab_task: Replace VPN access to an internal application with an identity-aware proxy, rotate a database secret automatically, and automate the response to a leaked-key finding.
days.deliverable: Access configuration, rotation evidence and automation logs
checks: Open the application without a valid identity
Application keeps working with the new secret
objectives: Apply zero trust to cloud applications

days.topic: Platform Engineering and Internal Developer Platforms
subtopics: Running the platform as a product
days.lab_task: Build a template that creates a repository, pipeline and cloud environment for a new service, then ship one change through it and record the lead time.
days.deliverable: Service template, created service and metrics
checks: Create a service from the template
Break a policy in the template input
Creation blocked with a clear message

subtopics: Global load balancing and DNS failover
days.lab_task: Run the sample service active-active in two regions behind global load balancing, inject a regional failure, and measure the effect on the SLO.
days.deliverable: Architecture, failure test results and SLO report
checks: Traffic moves to the other region within the target time
Write the same record in both regions
Conflict resolved by the stated rule
Compare the error budget before and after

subtopics: Managed ML platforms: SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning and Vertex AI
Cost controls for data and AI
days.lab_task: Design a governed lakehouse for two business domains, stream events into it, and serve one model through a managed ML platform with lineage recorded.
days.deliverable: Platform design, streaming evidence, model endpoint and lineage view
checks: Trace a report back to its source
All events land in the lakehouse table
Query another domain's data without access
objectives: Design data and AI platforms on the cloud
Govern data with ownership and lineage

days.lab_task: Assess a provided inventory of 20 applications, assign a strategy and wave to each, migrate one database with minimal downtime, and write the cutover and rollback plan.
days.deliverable: Assessment, wave plan, migration log and cutover plan
checks: Service back on the source system

subtopics: Regulated workloads in finance, health and government
Hybrid platforms: Azure Arc, Google Distributed Cloud and AWS Outposts
days.lab_task: For a regulated workload, choose regions and controls that meet a provided residency rule, use a key the provider does not hold, and produce an audit evidence pack.
days.deliverable: Control design, key configuration and evidence pack
checks: Encrypted data can no longer be read
An auditor asks for access evidence
The evidence pack answers the question

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Cloud Platform Design
days.lab_task: Design and partly build an enterprise cloud platform for a provided company: landing zone, guardrails, zero-trust access, a multi-region service, a cost model and a migration plan, then defend it to a review board.
days.deliverable: Design pack, working guardrails and service, cost model and a 20-minute presentation
checks: The board asks for the three biggest risks
Each has a mitigation and an owner
All guardrails block the test changes
objectives: Integrate governance, security, resilience and cost
Defend a design to a review board
